attchmntText: MIC Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MIC Electronics Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in Business Standard and Teluguprabha on November 10, 2026. Niwas Housing Finance Limited took symbolic possession of three properties in Cuddapah on November 5, 2026. The first property, belonging to Anchala Venkata Subbarayudu and Anchala Kanthamma, has an outstanding amount of Rs. 5,28,519. The second property, belonging to Gajula Prasad and Gajula Sugunamma, has an outstanding amount of Rs. 9,13,461. The third property, belonging to Bommalata Veera Brahmaiah Achari and others, has an outstanding amount of Rs. 11,65,201. A fourth borrower, Sripathi Kumari, is also listed with symbolic possession on November 4, 2026.

attchmntText: MIC Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 07, 2026.
voiceSummary: MIC Electronics Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 7, 2026, following a limited review by statutory auditors M/s. Bhavani & Co. For the standalone half year, revenue from operations was 3724.69 Lakhs, with a profit before tax of 540.19 Lakhs and net profit of 364.78 Lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 0.18. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was 13472.67 Lakhs, with a profit before tax of 673.45 Lakhs and net profit of 460.25 Lakhs. Consolidated earnings per share were 0.23. The company reported a net worth of 46115.77 Lakhs on a consolidated basis.
